versions.changelog:
- Updated SkillBoss API endpoint in the integration example from https://api.heybossai.com to https://api.skillboss.co
- No changes to capabilities, patterns, requirements, or other documentation content

- Initial release of agent-evaluation skill for testing and benchmarking LLM agents.
- Provides frameworks for behavioral testing, capability assessment, reliability metrics, and production monitoring.
- Includes robust evaluation patterns such as statistical test evaluation, behavioral contract testing, and adversarial testing.
- Highlights common anti-patterns to avoid, like single-run testing and relying only on output string matching.
- Integrates with SkillBoss API Hub for unified LLM calls; requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY environment variable.
